scope: Four 2D projects with appearance variants; two 3D prototypes with provisional existing art. Final 3D art and its variants will be supplied from Blender by Helena.
initialProjectScope: Opening, result-screen presentation, state control, Enter and restart are prepared in both starters. Firing, spawning, scores, lives and victory/defeat conditions remain for the student. Full authorship of the screen flow is deferred to Inventor.

cosmetics.rule: IR differs only in four visual choices
No claim of three 3D appearance variants in this delivery

2d.engine: Official game-2d runtime pinned to 9ca0696a; generated script.js; happy-dom with real native Canvas2D; no browser UI import performed

Opening creates no bullets or asteroids, and movement is gated
Enter begins; lateral movement and edge limit work
One press creates one shot; OS key repeat does not create a burst
Shot origin follows the current ship position
Offscreen shots are removed
Timer creates objects with the agreed constant cadence
One hit removes its two objects and awards exactly one point
Two simultaneous bullets cannot score the same asteroid twice
Escaped asteroid is cleaned without damage or points
Crash removes a target and damages only once during the protection interval
Simultaneous last hit and lethal crash produce defeat only
End blocks spawns, motion and scoring
Restart resets points, life, groups and ship position, preserving the skin
Reaching the goal with life produces victory
Repeated restart does not duplicate events or the spawn timer
Initial project runs, contains no game rules, and has the 12 selectable assets
Aurora: real-runtime render and asset load
Órbita: real-runtime render and asset load
Nebulosa: real-runtime render and asset load

2dInitial.scope: Focused initial-project regression using official runtime and exported script; result states forced only by the QA probe, not by learner starter code.

Only Enter and the drawing loop are supplied, with an empty Se jogando guard

Enter during playing does not restart the unfinished project

QA-forced derrota displays its prepared screen and Enter resets to opening
Supplied UI executes without missing variable, drawing or image errors

3d.engine: Official composed Jogo 3D runtime, official generated script and official asynchronous GLTFLoader; embedded GLB assets, real Three.js geometry and Canvas2D sky, WebGL drawing replaced by a no-op renderer

checks: All three embedded gallery GLBs load through the official asynchronous loader without fallback geometry
Opening blocks movement, spawning and firing
One shot per press, new copies move, origin follows the ship, lateral bound and fixed altitude
A hit consumes only its pair and scores once even with two simultaneous bullets; a miss does not score
Offscreen cleanup without damage or score
Native contact and one-second damage protection
Defeat wins a simultaneous final point/final life; final screen stops new actions
Native result button reruns the generated lifecycle and resets state
Spawn cadence is reset, victory works, repeated restart does not duplicate key handlers
All three embedded gallery GLBs load through the official asynchronous loader without fallback geometry
Prepared opening blocks movement and firing; Enter is the supplied start control
Starter runs 30 seconds after Enter with lateral control, without spawning, timers, points, life rules or ending conditions
Both prepared result screens and their supplied native reset return to opening, restore position and reload all models; QA-only triggers are absent from starter

runtimeProvenance: The 20-check 2D baseline predates the starter revision; all three complete 2D files are unchanged by SHA-256. Eight focused checks cover the updated 2D starter and identify its current SHA-256. The 3D report covers the current complete and updated starter.
limitations: Blockly executed headlessly with Happy DOM. The 2D runtime used real Canvas2D. The 3D runtime used the official asynchronous GLTFLoader and real Three.js geometry, with WebGL drawing replaced by a no-op renderer. Live Studio UI import and GPU rendering were not performed. All used field classes, block catalogs, mutators, codecs, schema, generators and import sanitizer are official sources.
